name: SSC Napoli

identity.playing_style: Conte's 2025/26 Napoli (2nd, 76 pts, 7 behind Inter) were an intense, physically demanding side alternating 4-3-3 and 3-5-2 with Rasmus Højlund (12 league goals) as focal point. Allegri, confirmed 3 July 2026 on a contract to 2029, historically prioritises defensive organisation, compactness and pragmatic control over pressing volume; expect fewer high-tempo phases and more emphasis on set pieces and transitions.
principles: buy players in the EUR 20-40m band, sell at peak
no over-30 long contracts as policy
identity.club_character: City-club with immense passion and pressure (Stadio Maradona); owner-president Aurelio De Laurentiis is outspoken and highly involved; media environment intense; two Scudetti in 2023 and 2025 raised expectations.
identity.ownership: Private, family-controlled: Filmauro / Aurelio De Laurentiis (since 2004)
identity.political_and_social_context: Publicly documented: De Laurentiis' recurring public disputes with the Italian FA, Serie A league body and UEFA over calendars and finances; club's stated opposition to certain league-governance reforms; long-running public negotiation with the Naples municipality over the Stadio Maradona. No further institution-level controversies verified for 2025/26.
identity.wage_structure: hierarchical with a firm ceiling; the club historically refuses to break its wage scale for individuals
identity.transfer_policy: data-and-scouting-led buys from mid-tier leagues, sells stars at peak value; heavy squad turnover in summer 2026 (see window)

strengths: Second-best team in Italy two seasons running (Scudetto 2025, 2nd with 76 pts in 2026).
Allegri's record of defensive organisation suits a league-phase format where avoiding defeats matters.
Højlund (12 league / 16 total goals in 2025/26) is a young, improving focal point.
Financially disciplined ownership; no FFP-driven fire sales.
weaknesses: Very large squad turnover (13+ verified departures incl. Lukaku, Lang, Lucca) plus a coaching change means a new identity is being built during the league phase.
Allegri's teams typically generate lower chance volume; goal supply beyond Højlund is unverified after Lukaku/Lucca exits.
Failed to defend the 2025 title (7 pts behind Inter) and exited the Coppa Italia at the quarter-final.
Champions League 2025/26 outcome could not be verified as a positive.

positional_needs.profile: physical target 9 as alternative to Højlund, 23-28
positional_needs.reason: Lukaku (to Fenerbahçe) and Lucca (to Nottingham Forest) both left; only Dinis Rodrigues verified as an incoming forward

positional_needs.profile: attacking full-back comfortable in back four or as wing-back
positional_needs.reason: Miguel Gutiérrez left for Bayer Leverkusen

Ages are computed from publicly known birth dates. Verified: coach Allegri (3 Jul 2026, to 2029), UCL opponents with venues (club site), 2nd place with 76 pts (Inter 83), Coppa Italia QF, Højlund 12/16 goals.
